public_rationale: The Tow Center study published on May 26, 2023 documents increased online coverage of ChatGPT in January and February 2023 [e1]. It provides no consistent historical comparison with other startups at comparable stages, establishing neither the claimed ranking nor a counterexample other than Facebook [e1].
limitations: The study does not cover the full target period, November 30, 2022 through February 17, 2025 [e1].
The evidence lacks matched historical startup comparisons using consistent archives, outlets, languages, search terms and duplicate handling [e1].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Apart from perhaps Facebook, no startup has had as much media coverage so early as ChatGPT/OpenAI.

statement.excerpt: There isn't a single god damn startup in the history of anything — other than perhaps Facebook — that has had this level of coverage at such an early stage.

from_speaker: There isn't a single god damn startup
our_interpretation: The plain reading is a comparison of the amount of news coverage, not audience size or product adoption.
The surrounding discussion makes ChatGPT's public launch the starting point. The observation covers launch through the post date.
Comparable stages mean comparable elapsed time after a startup's principal product launch. This is an interpretation; company age would give a different comparison.
Facebook is excluded from potential counterexamples.
criteria.support_condition: A sufficiently comprehensive historical comparison finds that no other startup matched ChatGPT/OpenAI's coverage at a comparable early stage.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one startup other than Facebook matched or exceeded that coverage under a consistent measurement and comparable stage.

evidence.explanation: The study documents substantial early coverage using Media Cloud and television archives. Its comparisons with technology categories do not establish the claim about every other startup.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A reproducible historical comparison using consistent coverage measures and comparable time since principal product launch. A sufficiently comprehensive comparison could support the ranking; one startup other than Facebook matching or exceeding ChatGPT/OpenAI's coverage would contradict it.
